      "snippet": "Good catch. This is not a whisper problem and not a MetaBlooms mistake. This is an Android execution policy issue, and it has a known, clean workaround.

What the error actually means (precise)
bashCopy codebash: ./whisper: Permission denied

On Android, files in /storage/emulated/0 are mounted noexec.
That means:

You can read and write binaries there

You cannot execute them directly from that filesystem

chmod +x alone is not sufficient

This is expected behavior on modern Android.
